title: StreetSnapshot
description: street.json of a published map version, schema_version 1 (docs/snapshot-format.md): the street graph imported from OpenStreetMap (street_nodes and street_edges), under the ODbL, kept in its own file apart from the indoor data (docs/decisions/0003-routing.md). Checked by the validator, not by this schema: at most 7 decimals in coordinates, latitudes within -90 to 90, street node ids unique, every edge's from_osm_node and to_osm_node is a street node in the file, every edge's line starts exactly at from_osm_node and ends exactly at to_osm_node, and features sorted with nodes first (by id), then edges (by osm_way_id, from_osm_node, to_osm_node).

features.description: Street nodes, then street edges. At most 200000.

source.title: StreetSource
source.description: Where the street graph comes from and its licence. Clients show the attribution wherever the street graph is used.

feature.title: StreetFeature
feature.description: One feature of street.json; properties.feature_type says which kind.

node.title: StreetNodeFeature
node.description: A vertex of the street graph (street_nodes).

nodeProperties.title: StreetNodeProperties
nodeProperties.description: A street node has no other properties.

edge.title: StreetEdgeFeature
edge.description: A footpath segment between two street nodes (street_edges). It has no feature id: street_edges.id changes on every import, so an edge is identified by osm_way_id, from_osm_node and to_osm_node.

geometry.description: street_edges.geom, running from from_osm_node to to_osm_node: its first position is exactly from_osm_node's and its last exactly to_osm_node's.

edgeProperties.title: StreetEdgeProperties
edgeProperties.description: What clients need of a street edge. Street edges are walkable both ways.

osm_way_id.description: The OpenStreetMap way the segment belongs to.

from_osm_node.description: One end: a street_node feature's id.

to_osm_node.description: The other end: a street_node feature's id.

highway.description: The way's OpenStreetMap highway tag, for example footway, pedestrian or steps; null if it has none. Step-free routing avoids steps.

footway.description: The way's OpenStreetMap footway tag, for example sidewalk or crossing; null if it has none.

covered.description: Under cover: covered=yes, or the import's tunnel, building and roof heuristics.

length_m.description: Length in metres, measured in SVY21, rounded to 2 decimals.
